note: Set A covers 25 claims and gets 22 of them right, including equipment, finish and plumbing facts (washing machine model/manufacturer, VCT and accent paint attributes, wall base material, shower valve manufacturer) that Set B omits entirely. Set B's 11 claims are all correct but leave out a large amount of important schedule data. However, A contains three serious cross-row misbindings: it assigns the floor-finish (VT) attributes 'STANDARD EXCELON' and '51899' to SHOWER VALVE and the plumbing (SV) model 'T17059' to VINYL COMPOSITE TILE. Both sets repeat the MWK04, MWK05 and MWB01 dimension facts under two names.
remarks: The text layer of the MILLWORK SCHEDULE is row-offset (tags appear after the description/dimension lines), so tag-to-row binding must be checked against the image; both sets bind MWK01–MWK05, MWB01–MWB03, MWD01/MWD02 correctly. The three A errors look like a row-merge failure between the PLUMBING SCHEDULE (SV) and FLOOR FINISH SCHEDULE (VT) blocks. Entity 'MWK01' in both sets is tag-only with no description, and the duplicated MWK04/MWK05/MWB01 claims are stated once with a tag condition and once with 'Millwork Schedule'.
